# Change

Describe the learner-facing result, phase, and scope.

## Validation

- [ ] Markdown and local links pass.
- [ ] Applicable lint and tests pass.
- [ ] No credentials or private data.
- [ ] Progress and navigation updated.
- [ ] Owner approval recorded before phase merge.

## Evidence and approval

Link test evidence, review notes, and the explicit owner approval. Unchecked approval means do not merge.
